reference.title: Calibration of the ruby pressure gauge to 800 kbar under quasi-hydrostatic conditions

methods.scope: selected observations in experiment I; used as cross-check

recalculation.notes: The supplement gives corrected sample pressures but no row-wise ruby wavelengths or Au lattice parameters.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the primary article and official MSA supplemental tables; LitCurate was discovery-only.

primary_source_check.finding: The paper identifies exact MgSi(OH)6, P21, Z=2 and reports this BM3 as the preferred experimental description.

primary_data_check.finding: All 95 reported P-V observations, including experiment and loading path, are bundled verbatim.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Abstract; Experimental and computational methods; Equations 1-3; Table 2; Figure 3.
parameter_provenance.equation: Equations 1-3 and Table 2: third-order Birch finite-strain EOS (BM3).
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 2: 194.52(2) A3, fixed to the high-precision value measured on the same material by Wunder et al. (2012).
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table 2: 4.9(2). The abstract instead prints +/-0.1; the detailed parameter table is authoritative here.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Parenthetical/plus-minus errors are published without an explicit confidence convention; V0 was fixed rather than freely refined.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: The source describes third- and fourth-order fits to the experimental data and deposits all 95 P-V observations, but does not publish a machine-readable row mask, weights, covariance, or regression objective.

superseded_record_text.notes: Preferred source fit. Table 2's K0' uncertainty (0.2) is stored instead of the abstract's inconsistent 0.1.
validity_notes: The range is the measured room-temperature envelope, including decompression to ambient pressure; it is not a thermodynamic stability field.
The 3.65 A phase is expected to form from the 10 A phase near 9-10 GPa but was retained metastably below that pressure.

recalculation.notes: No row-wise ruby wavelengths or Au lattice parameters are deposited.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against Equations 1-3, Table 2, Figure 3d, and the official supplemental table.

primary_source_check.finding: The complete BM4 parameters are source-reported; LitCurate omitted K0' and K0''.

primary_data_check.finding: The BM4 sensitivity fit shares the full official experimental P-V table with BM3.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Equations 1-3; Table 2; Figure 3d.
parameter_provenance.equation: Equations 1-3 and Table 2: fourth-order Birch finite-strain EOS (BM4).
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Same deposited 95-point experimental P-V series as the BM3; retained separately because the source explicitly reports the full higher-order coefficient set.

superseded_record_text.notes: Sensitivity record only; intentionally has no default_for. Its K0, K0', and K0'' are strongly covariant and the source does not publish covariance.
validity_notes: Higher-order sensitivity parameterization of the same experimental observations, not the paper's preferred EOS.
Do not extrapolate K0'' outside the measured compression envelope.

recalculation.notes: No experimental pressure calibration applies to a static first-principles model.

assessment.basis: The full four-coefficient BM4 is tabulated and the computed P-V markers are plotted, but the numerical energy-volume grid is not deposited; no false-precision digitization is bundled.

scientific_validation.note: Validated independently against the primary paper's equations, computational methods, Table 2, and Figure 3a.

primary_source_check.finding: This is a separate theoretical BM4 parameterization of the stoichiometric P21 model crystal, not another fit to the experimental P-V table.

primary_data_check.finding: The full four-coefficient BM4 is tabulated and the computed P-V markers are plotted, but the numerical energy-volume grid is not deposited; no false-precision digitization is bundled.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Mookherjee (2015), static GGA model-crystal calculation: computed compression determines this BM4, separately from the two experimental fits in the same paper.
parameter_provenance.equation: Table 2 labels the first-principles result fourth-order; Equations 1-3 define the BM4 convention.
parameter_provenance.model: Methods: PAW-GGA in VASP, 1000 eV cutoff, 2x2x2 Monkhorst-Pack grid, P21 primitive cell; total energies converged within 5 meV/atom.

superseded_record_text.notes: Clearly distinct theoretical record. No default_for is assigned; the preferred catalog equilibrium record is the experimental BM3.
validity_notes: Static PAW-GGA model-crystal curve; it is not an experimental ambient-temperature fit.
The numerical energy-volume grid is not tabulated; the bounds conservatively follow the green Figure 3a calculation markers.
